$description: Design For Humans - Tier 2 Semantic UI Design Tokens (W3C DTCG Standard)

default.$description: How much of a translucent colour shows through, by default

subtle.$description: The faintest translucency: a colour barely tinting what is under it

quiet.$description: A light translucency, for quiet tints

strong.$description: A strong translucency: mostly the colour, a little of what is under it

stronger.$description: The strongest translucency, nearly solid; reduced transparency goes solid

faint.$description: A surface barely tinted: the inverted surface mixed this far towards transparent (--surface-translucent).

lg.$description: A strong backdrop blur, for translucent materials

default.$description: The backdrop blur translucent surfaces use by default

muted.$description: Semi-transparent muted tint based on current text color

quiet.$description: Low-contrast subtle tint for dividers and hair-lines

backdrop.$description: Overlay scrim background for modal dialogs

overlay.$value: light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.000}, transparent {translucency.33}), color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.900}, transparent {translucency.33}))
overlay.$description: Translucent surface layer for sticky navigation and floating panels

filter.$description: Backdrop blur filter for glassmorphic layers

subtle.$description: A barely tinted page background, for a section that should sit apart quietly

muted.$description: Subtle surface background for page canvas

inverted.$description: Inverted contrast background for tooltips and contrast banners

card.$description: Elevated card, dialog, popover, and panel background

card-inverted.$description: Inverted contrast card, dialog, popover, and panel background

dark.$description: Dark container background for footer and media asides

darker.$description: Maximum depth background for deep containers

layer.$value: light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, {color.white}, transparent {translucency.10}), color-mix(in srgb, {color.black}, transparent {translucency.10}))
layer.$description: Layer surface background for floating or sticky elements

accent.$description: Light tint accent surface for badges and highlighted areas

accent-strong.$description: High-contrast accent surface for primary interactive elements

complementary.$description: Light tint complementary surface for badges and highlighted areas

complementary-strong.$description: High-contrast complementary surface for primary interactive elements

translucent.$description: Gentle hover tint on interactive surfaces

translucent-strong.$description: Stronger hover tint on interactive surfaces

shade.$value: light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.1000}, transparent {translucency.95}), color-mix(in srgb, {color.black}, transparent {translucency.70}))

danger.$description: Destructive or error alert banner background

danger-strong.$description: High-contrast danger surface for strong alert banners and callouts

warning.$description: Warning banner and callout background: something needs attention

warning-strong.$description: High-contrast warning surface for strong alert banners and callouts

success.$description: Positive feedback or completed status banner background

success-strong.$description: High-contrast success surface for strong alert banners and callouts

info.$description: Information banner and callout background: neutral news

info-strong.$description: High-contrast info surface for strong alert banners and callouts

foreground.$description: Text, typography, and icon color fills

default.$description: High-contrast primary body copy and headings (WCAG AAA >= 7:1)

on-dark.$description: Text on a dark band or media that stays dark in both modes

white.$description: White text, for a surface that is dark in both modes

muted.$description: Secondary subtext, timestamps, and captions (WCAG AA >= 4.5:1)

accent.$description: Brand links, active navigation items, focus states

accent-hover.$description: Hover state for links and accent buttons

accent-pressed.$description: Active / pressed state for links and accent buttons

complementary.$description: Complementary links, active navigation items, focus states

complementary-hover.$description: Complementary hover state for links and buttons

complementary-pressed.$description: Active / pressed state for complementary buttons

danger.$description: Destructive button text, form error messages

success.$description: Success checkmark icons and completed status text

warning.$description: Warning callout text and pending status icons

control.$description: Form control boundary: 67% of the text colour, at least 3:1 against the page in both schemes (WCAG 1.4.11)

none.$description: No border. Stays 0 whatever the theme.

muted.$description: Opacity for content that should recede

compact.$description: Gap between items in a compact region (layout primitives step down to it)

2xs.$description: Spacing step 2xs (2px): margin, padding and gap utilities

xs.$description: Spacing step xs (4px): margin, padding and gap utilities

sm.$description: Spacing step sm (8px): margin, padding and gap utilities

md.$description: Spacing step md (16px): margin, padding and gap utilities

lg.$description: Spacing step lg (32px): margin, padding and gap utilities

xl.$description: Spacing step xl (48px): margin, padding and gap utilities

2xl.$description: Spacing step 2xl (64px): margin, padding and gap utilities

3xl.$description: Spacing step 3xl (128px): margin, padding and gap utilities

target.$description: Touch target size (48px / 3rem, above the 44px of WCAG 2.5.5): every control keeps it as its hit area

target-sm.$description: Small target size (32px / 2rem): the fine-pointer target a product can opt into, and the height of --sm text controls. Never under 24px (WCAG 2.5.8)

target-lg.$description: Large target size (64px / 4rem), for a control that needs more

target-min.$description: Minimum hit area for every interactive control. Defaults to the 48px touch target; a product that opts into fine-pointer targets sets it to spacing.target-sm (PRINCIPLES §2).

site-width.$description: The page's content width: the Wrapper's cap, and the Header and Footer bars'

breathe.$description: Fluid breathing space between major container sections

cushion.$description: Double fluid cushion space for outer page and hero margins

cq-breathe.$description: Container-fluid breathing space using container query cqi units

cq-cushion.$description: Double container-fluid cushion space using container query cqi units

breathe-sm.$description: A smaller breathing space, for tighter groups

cq-breathe-sm.$description: A smaller breathing space, for tighter groups, growing with its container (cqi)

cushion-lg.$description: A larger cushion, for page sections and heroes

cq-cushion-lg.$description: A larger cushion, for page sections and heroes, growing with its container (cqi)

black.$description: The heaviest weight: display titles in fonts that have it

font-family.$description: The body font: running text and interface copy

measure.$description: Longest comfortable line for reading text (about 45 to 75 characters). Set to none on a container to lift it.

font-family.$description: Micro heading font (.micro-heading: the uppercase eyebrow)

font-size.$description: Micro heading size: the same at every width
Micro heading size in a compact region
Title size: the same at every width
Title size in a compact region
Title size growing with the screen
Title size growing with its container

font-family.$description: Display title font (.display-title: hero and cover titles)

font-size.$description: Display title size: the same at every width
Display title size in a compact region
Display title size growing with the screen

Standard font size for interactive control elements like buttons and inputs

border-color.$description: A control's edge colour: 3:1 against its background (WCAG 1.4.11)

font-size.$description: Small control typography font size

line-height.$description: Line height inside small single-line controls

font-size.$description: Large control typography font size

line-height.$description: Line height inside large single-line controls

border-width.$description: Standard border stroke thickness for major application landmark components (header, sidebar, footer)

border-color.$description: Standard border stroke color for major application landmark components (header, sidebar, footer)

border-style.$description: Standard border stroke style for major application landmark components (header, sidebar, footer)

padding-inline.$description: The inline padding of the landmarks (Header, Sidebar, Footer), so their content lines up. Resolved on :root, so a compact region inside the page doesn't move it; .ui-compact on the root does

sidebar-width.$description: The app's sidebar column: the Sidebar's width, and what a split--sidebar lines up with. A compact region (.ui-compact) takes it to sidebar-compact-width

sidebar-compact-width.$description: The sidebar column in a compact region

border-width.$description: Edge width of panels: cards, tables, menus

border-color.$description: Edge colour of panels: cards, tables, menus

radius.$description: Corner radius of panels: cards, tables, menus

width.$description: Width of dividers and rules between items

color.$description: Colour of dividers and rules between items

style.$description: Style of dividers and rules (solid, dashed)

none.$description: Square corners. Stays 0 whatever the theme.

default.$description: Corner radius for controls and small components

lg.$description: Large corner radius, for larger surfaces

offset.$description: Gap between text and its link underline

font-size.$description: Size for superscript and subscript

offset.$description: Gap between a control and its focus ring

clearance.$description: Room a focus ring needs outside a control, so containers do not clip it

none.$description: No transition; reduced motion takes every duration here

md.$description: Medium transitions: opening and closing small parts

lg.$description: Long transitions: dialogs, drawers and larger movement

enter.$description: The scale an overlay (Dialog, Popover, Tooltip, Toast) grows from as it opens and shrinks to as it closes

in-out.$description: Easing for movement that starts and stops on screen

in.$description: Easing for things leaving the screen

out.$description: Easing for things arriving on screen

bounce.$description: An overshooting ease, for playful emphasis; use sparingly

color.$value: light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.900}, transparent {translucency.90}), color-mix(in srgb, {color.black}, transparent {translucency.25}))

color-light.$value: light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.800}, transparent {translucency.95}), color-mix(in srgb, {color.black}, transparent {translucency.50}))

sm.$description: Subtle card & resting surface stacked elevation

md.$description: Medium stacked elevation for popovers and hover states

lg.$description: High stacked elevation for modals, flyouts, and floating overlays

inner.$description: Inset stacked shadow for wells and pressed states

sm-light.$description: Light tint subtle card & resting surface stacked elevation

md-light.$description: Light tint medium stacked elevation for popovers and hover states

lg-light.$description: Light tint high stacked elevation for modals and floating overlays

inner-light.$description: Light tint inset stacked shadow for wells and pressed states

raised.$description: Elevated hover or focused surface shadow

reset.$description: Shadow reset for active or flat states

deep.$description: Below the page: backgrounds behind content

shade.$value: light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.1000}, transparent {translucency.90}), color-mix(in srgb, {color.black}, transparent {translucency.50}))

overlay.$value: light-dark(color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.000}, transparent {translucency.25}), color-mix(in srgb, {color.neutral.900}, transparent {translucency.25}))
